An easy starting task for new elementalists, go and fetch an nearby item.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Elementalist
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Go to the beach and find a [[Stone of the Elements]].
* Defeat [[Huan]] to claim ownership of the Stone of the Elements.
* See Ronsu for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Ronsu teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
** {{skill icon|Armor of Earth}}
** {{skill icon|Ice Spikes}}

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Just go south to the sea, and out the pier. Huan should not be difficult, and if he is, fetch some allies from [[Shing Jea Monastery]] to help. Henchmen should do fine.

==NPCs and objects==
===Foes===
*{{e}} 5 (20) [[Huan]]

===Objects===
*[[Stone of the Elements|The Stone of the Elements]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ronsu
''In order to command the elements, one must first live with them, contemplate them, learn from them. Go down to the [[Sunqua Vale|beach]] and find a [[Stone of the Elements]], they often wash ashore there. Bring it back to me so we can study it together.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = A Stone of the Elements? As you wish....
| decline =  I am not in the mood for beachcombing.
| ask = You think I joke with you, sending you to the beach for rocks? Well, you will see what you will see. The [[Sunqua Vale|beach]] is to the south, by the way. Bring me a [[Stone of the Elements]] when you are ready to continue.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Huan''': ''"You are searching for a Stone of the Elements, are you not? Well, your luck is bad. This one is mine!"''
:'''Huan''': ''"You can have it if you can best me in a duel...."''
:'''Huan''': ''"Prepare to die!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Ronsu
''Yes, I knew Huan would also be there. I sent him myself. Now you know the true task I set you, and you performed as expected. You appear to have the patience required to become an Elementalist.''

==Notes==
* Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with completion of this quest.
